title: Container Report - Week 35
summary:
Container
It has been a flat week across the key FBX trade lanes. The Panama Canal transit authority has advised that due to lower water levels they are reducing the number of daily transits and reducing the maximum allowed draft levels, which will have a knock-on effect on FBX03 to the USEC. This will mean less containers being carried on each vessel due to the draft restrictions and if it worsens will cause most vessels to have to divert via the Cape of Good Hope, tying up tonnage for longer and increasing costs.
